rationale: 'Dance, Dance' is track 3 on the original studio album 'From Under the Cork Tree' (2005). It appears as 'Believers Never Die – Greatest Hits' (2009) is a later compilation; the original/canonical release is 'From Under the Cork Tree' (2005). | sources: https://shop.udiscovermusic.com/collections/fall-out-boy/products/fall-out-boy-from-under-the-cork-tree-cd, https://www.discogs.com/master/119726-Fall-Out-Boy-From-Under-The-Cork-Tree
